sources.title: Jean-Luc Guermond, MATH 661 Fall 2025, Part VIII, Chapter 38: Discontinuous Galerkin
sources.locator: Complete 14-page chapter inspected; §§38.2.1–38.2.3 and §38.5, printed pp. 192–199: SIP definitions and boundary convention, exact consistency, inverse-trace coercivity, energy error, dual regularity index s>1/2, and L2 estimate. The remaining chapter sections were inspected for stated scope and excluded variations.

contents.name: §38.2.1, Definition 38.1 and equation (38.4): interior jump/average and boundary one-sided convention
contents.reason: The local definition fixes the same orientation and one-sided boundary convention, then states the scalar jump independently of diagrams.

contents.name: §38.2.1, equation (38.4): symmetric interior-penalty form and gamma0/hF penalty
contents.reason: The local form states the real scalar piecewise-constant SPD coefficient branch, the exact boundary terms, and its energy and augmented expressions.

contents.name: §38.2.2, discrete trace inequality (38.10) and Lemma 38.5
contents.reason: The local proof derives the coefficient-flux version from the published polynomial inverse-trace estimate and explicitly sums the cell-face incidence count.

contents.name: §38.2.2, equation (38.7): broken gradient plus weighted jump energy norm
contents.reason: The local proof checks definiteness componentwise under the homogeneous boundary-facet convention and verifies the product-norm triangle inequality.

contents.name: §38.2.1, Lemma 38.2: exact consistency by elementwise Green identities
contents.reason: The local proof records matching traces, zero boundary traces, cellwise strong equations, and normal-flux continuity as separate hypotheses.

contents.name: §38.2.1 and §38.2.3: symmetry/adjoint consistency and the dual identity used in the L2 estimate
contents.reason: The local H2 branch proves the identity from simplex Green formulas and states the exact matching-flux and boundary hypotheses.

contents.name: §38.2.2, Lemma 38.6: coercivity for gamma0 greater than the face-count times the squared inverse-trace constant
contents.reason: The local threshold follows from the proved coefficient-flux bound and Young's inequality; no universal threshold is claimed.

contents.name: §38.2.3, Theorem 38.10: consistency, boundedness, coercivity, and approximation give an energy error bound
contents.reason: The local error estimate is proved directly from the SIP residual and its stated augmented approximation expression.

contents.name: §38.2.3, Theorem 38.12: dual regularity index s in (1/2,1] and the h^s ellOmega^(1-s) L2 estimate
contents.reason: The local theorem preserves s and explicitly assumes adjoint consistency and face-aware dual approximation; it does not infer those hypotheses from regularity alone.

contents.name: §38.2.1 and §38.3, printed pp. 193–194 and 197–198: affine-cell traces, Green identity, and bounded SIP residual
contents.reason: The chapter uses elementwise traces and Green identities on physical affine cells; the local proof transports the reference-simplex trace theorem through the affine map instead of assuming the physical-cell formula.

contents.name: §38.3, Lemma 38.9, printed pp. 197–198: boundedness of the face consistency terms in a face-aware norm
contents.reason: The local proof derives the coefficient-weighted SIP bound, including both flux-jump terms, in the augmented norm on the explicitly defined form domain.

sources.title: Douglas N. Arnold, Franco Brezzi, Bernardo Cockburn, and L. Donatella Marini, Unified Analysis of Discontinuous Galerkin Methods for Elliptic Problems, SIAM Journal on Numerical Analysis 39(5) (2002), pp. 1749–1779
sources.locator: Complete 32-page paper inspected; §§3.1–3.3, 4.1–4.3, and 5.1, printed pp. 1756–1768: primal SIP formulation and face identities, consistency/adjoint consistency, face boundedness and stability, approximation, energy and L2 duality arguments. The remaining sections were inspected to distinguish nonsymmetric, superpenalized, and unstable variants.

contents.name: §3.1–3.2, printed pp. 1756–1758: orientation-invariant jump/average identities and primal DG form
contents.reason: This independent paper confirms the face algebra and the need to fix conventions before writing the primal form.

contents.name: §3.2, Table 3.1 and equation (3.11): interior-penalty primal form with two consistency terms and stabilization
contents.reason: The local definition specializes the primal form to the real scalar piecewise-constant SPD coefficient setting.

contents.name: §4.1, printed pp. 1763–1764: boundedness via inverse trace and face scaling
contents.reason: It independently supports the scaling argument; the local proof gives all coefficient and face-count constants needed here.

contents.name: §4.1, mesh-dependent norms and discrete Poincare discussion, printed p. 1763
contents.reason: The local proof verifies definiteness directly from cell constants, interior jumps, and boundary traces rather than importing a discrete Poincare result.

contents.name: §3.3, printed pp. 1758–1759: consistency condition and Galerkin orthogonality
contents.reason: The local proof carries the exact interface-flux continuity and zero-boundary hypotheses needed for its selected coefficient branch.

contents.name: §3.3 and §5.1, printed pp. 1758–1759 and 1767–1768: adjoint consistency and duality identity
contents.reason: The local H2 proof supplies the Green-identity details that the paper uses as the adjoint-consistency condition.

contents.name: §4.2, printed pp. 1765–1766: penalty terms absorb consistency terms above a threshold
contents.reason: The local proof provides an explicit sufficient threshold from its coefficient-flux trace constant.

contents.name: §5.1, printed pp. 1767–1768: consistency, stability, boundedness, and approximation yield the DG energy estimate
contents.reason: The local proof derives a direct SIP-specific residual estimate, with its augmented face-flux approximation term shown explicitly.

contents.name: §5.1, printed pp. 1767–1768: adjoint-consistency hypothesis in the L2 duality argument
contents.reason: The local result retains this hypothesis and adds the exact face-aware dual approximation condition instead of asserting an unstated rate.

contents.name: §§3.1–3.3 and §4.1, printed pp. 1756–1759 and 1763–1764: affine-cell traces, Green identity, and primal-form boundedness
contents.reason: The paper states the broken Sobolev trace setting and elementwise Green identity; the local proof gives the affine transfer needed on each physical simplex.

contents.name: §4.1, printed pp. 1763–1764: boundedness of primal DG face and volume terms in the stronger norm
contents.reason: The local proof independently bounds the real scalar symmetric form with its coefficient and penalty weights and records the exact constant used downstream.
